parts.label: Upward number flux
parts.help: Statement §1(a), solution §(a)(i). Dilute isotropic Maxwell–Boltzmann gas; all scales positive.

parts.label: Mean x-momentum transferred per crossing molecule
parts.help: Statement §1(b), solution §(a)(ii). Use G = d⟨vx⟩/dz. Flux-weighted angular average; transfer to the faster layer is negative for G > 0.

parts.label: Viscosity temperature exponent α
parts.help: Statement §1(c), solution §(a)(iii); b ≪ λ ≪ D, dilute gas.

parts.label: Viscosity coefficient ξ
parts.help: The number density cancels; b is molecular diameter; positive scales, dilute-gas approximation.

parts.label: Axial velocity profile
parts.help: Statement §2(a), solution §(b)(i). Use G = dp/dx, signed pressure gradient; η, R > 0, 0 ≤ r ≤ R; steady nearly incompressible Poiseuille flow.

parts.label: Volumetric flow rate
parts.help: Use G = dp/dx, negative for positive flow; fully developed nearly incompressible flow.

parts.label: Wall heat per unit time per unit length
parts.help: Use G = dp/dx. Pressure-work dissipation is removed as wall heat; steady nearly incompressible flow. Isothermal compressible gas alone does not justify this formula.
